Short title and Commencement

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
1. Short title and
Commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan
Juniper University Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Establishment and Incorporation of the University

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
3. Establishment and
Incorporation of the University.‑‑(1) There shall be
established at Quetta a University to be called the Juniper University
consisting of;
(a) the Patron, the Chancellor,
the Pro‑Chancellor, the Pro‑Vice -Chancellor, the Vice‑Chancellor,
Deans and other members of the Council and Board of Governors;
(b) the member of such councils,
committees and other bodies as the Board may establish;
(c) the teachers and students of
the University and its constituent units; and
(d) such other officers and
members of the staff as may from time to time be specified by the Board.
(2) The University shall be a
body corporate by the name of the Juniper University having perpetual
succession and a common seal, and may by the said name sue and be sued. .
(3) The University shall be
competent to acquire and hold property both movable and immovable, or sell or
otherwise transfer any property vested in it or enter into contract for the
purposes of this Ordinance.

Powers and function of the University

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
4. Powers and functions of the
University. The University shall have powers to:
(a) to provide for instruction
and training in business, technology, health and medical sciences and in such
other branches of learning as it may deem fit, and to make provision for
research demonstration and other services, and for the advancement and
dissemination of knowledge in such manner as it may determine;
(b) to print, publish and
circulate periodicals, journals, magzines and books and disseminate scientific,
technological and other related knowledge and information conducive to the
attainment of any of the objectives of the University;
(c) to promote contacts and establish
liaison with national and international University, institutions and other
research and development organizations within the Province, Country and abroad
for effective discharge of its functions and responsibilities;
(d) to provide assistance to the industry,
Government institutions and organizations in the Province, country and abroad
through expert advisors, consultants and in any other manner as it may deem
fit;
(e) to undertake joint
investigation and collaborative research in the field of business education,
health sciences, technology and other allied matter;
(f) to pursue and make provision
for research, innovations, inventions, demonstrations and other services as it
may deem fit;
(g) to admit and examine
students;
(h) to hold examinations and
confer or award degrees, diplomas, certificates, academic and research prizes
and distinctions on and to persons who fulfill the requirements or have passed
its examinations under the prescribed conditions in accordance with the rules
and regulations;
(i) to provide for the teaching
of specified courses and training for persons not being the students of the
University and grant certificates and diplomas to such persons;
(j) to recognize examinations
passed or the period of study spent at other Universities or places of learning
as equivalent to examinations or periods of study in the University;
(k) to create posts for teaching,
research, extensions, administration, training and for any other purposes
related thereto and appoint persons thereto;
(l) to affiliate and disaffiliate
educational institutions and inspect such institutions, or associate itself
with other selected educational training and research institutions, provide
them with services and facilities for the effective discharge of their functions
and responsibilities and determine teaching methodology, techniques and
strategies in order to ensure the most effective educational training and
research programmes;
(m) to institute and award
fellowships, scholarships stipends, bursaries, medals and prizes;
(n) to establish, administer and
maintain school, college, institute and hall of residence and approve any place
as hostel or lodging for the students and to supervise and control the
discipline of the students of the University and promote extra curricular and
recreational activities of such students, and to make arrangements for
promoting their health and general welfare;
(o) to receive and manage
property, grants, bequests, gifts, donations, endowments and other
contributions made to the University and to invest them in such manner as it
may deem fit.
(p) to charge and receive such
fees and other payments as it may determine;
(q) to authorize and agree to the
mobility of qualified staff among universities, research and Development
Organizations in the Government or corporate bodies on the terms and conditions
laid down in the rules

The University Open for all

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
5. The University Open for
all.‑‑The University shall be open to persons of either sex of
whatever religion, race, creed, colour, or domicile who are academically
qualified for admission to its courses of study offered by the University, and
no such person shall be denied the privileges of the University on the ground
only of sex, religion, creed, race, class, colour or domicile.

Teaching and Examination

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
6. Teaching and Examination.‑‑(1)
The academic programme of University shall be conducted in the manner as laid
down in the Rules and Regulations.
(2) The University shall
associate external examiners for the conduct of examination and viva voce.
(3) No degree shall be granted
unless a student has passed an examination in Islamic Studies and Pakistan
Studies and Ethics at the Bachelors degree level or in the case of a Non‑Muslim
student in Ethics and Pakistan Studies at his option.

Officers of the University

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
7. Officers of the University.‑‑The
following shall be the officers of the University;‑‑‑
(a) The Patron
(b) The Chancellor
(c) The Pro‑Chancellor
(d) The Vice‑Chancellor
(e) The Pro‑Vice‑Chancellor
(f) The Deans; and
(g) Such other persons as may be
specified by the Rules or Regulations to be officers of the University.

The Patron

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
8. The Patron.‑‑The
Governor of Balochistan shall be the Patron of the University.

The Chancellor

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
9. The Chancellor.‑‑(1)
The Chancellor shall be a person of eminence known for his contributions in the
field of knowledge or service to Society and appointed for his high moral and
intellectual caliber;
(2) The Chancellor shall be
appointed by the Patron on the recommendations jointly made by the Board and
the Society on the terms and conditions as the Patron may determine;
(3) The Chancellor shall, when present
preside all convocations of the University, and in his absence, a person
nominated by him shall preside.
(4) The Chancellor shall direct
the Vice‑Chancellor to cause visitation in accordance with provision of
section 10.
(5) Every proposal to confer an
honorary degree shall be subject to confirmation by the Chancellor.
(6) If the Chancellor be
incapacitated from acting as such due to absence or any other cause, the Vice‑Chancellor
shall act for him.

Visitation

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
10. Visitation.‑‑(1)
The Chancellor may cause an inspection or inquiry to be made in respect of any
matter connected with the affairs of the University and shall, from time to
time, direct one or more persons or organization to inquire in to or carry out
inspection of;
(a) the University, its
buildings, laboratories, libraries, and other facilities;
(b) any institution, department,
school, college or hostel maintained by the University; ,
(c) the adequacy of financial or
human resources;
(d) the teaching, research,
curriculum, examinations and other matters of the University;
(e) such other matters as may be
specified by him.
(2) The Chancellor shall communicate
to the Board his views with regard to the result of an inspection or inquiry
and shall, after ascertaining the view of the Board, advise the Board on the
action to be taken by it.
(3) The Board shall, within such
time as may be specified, by the Chancellor, communicate to him such action, if
any, as has been taken or may be proposed to be taken upon the result of an
inspection or inquiry.
(4) Where the Board does not,
within the time specified, take action to the satisfaction of the Chancellor, the
Chancellor may issue such directions as he thinks fit and the Board shall
comply with all such directions.

The Vice-Chancellor

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
11. The Vice‑Chancellor.‑‑(1)
The Vice‑Chancellor shall be appointed by the Chancellor in consultation
with the Board of Governors for such period and on such terms and conditions as
the Chancellor may determine, and shall perform such duties as the Chancellor
may direct.
(2) The Vice‑Chancellor
shall exercise general control and supervision over the affairs of the
University and shall ensure that the provisions of this Ordinance, the
regulations, the rules, policies and directions of the Board, Committee and the
Council are properly executed.
(3) The Vice‑Chancellor
shall perform such other functions as may be entrusted to him by the
Chancellor, the Board, the Committee or the Council and, in particular, shall:
(a) submit plans of work and
budget estimates of the University for recommendations of the Council and
thereafter, for approval of the Committee;
(b) submit to the Committee, in
accordance with the Rules of Procedures made by it, reports, on the activities
of the University and the execution of the plans of work; and
(c) provide necessary service to
the Board and the Committee.
(4) The Vice‑Chancellor
shall also have the power;
(a) to supervise the activities
connected with the execution of programmes for instruction, training, research,
demonstration, inventions, innovations and other services;
(b) to authorize expenditure
provided for in the budget in accordance with the rules;
(c) to appoint, with the approval
of the Committee, teachers, officers and members of the staff of the University
and such other persons as may be necessary in accordance with the Rules so as
to ensure the highest intellectual and moral qualities in the persons appointed;
(d) to re‑appropriate funds
within the approved budget
(e) to sanction by re‑appropriation
an amount not exceeding a sum specified in the Rules and Regulations for an
unforeseen item not provided for in the Budget, and report it to the Committee;
(f)‑to engage experts and
consultants as may be required for efficient and effective discharge of the
functions of the University;
(g) to constitute from amongst
the officers and staff of the University such Committee, sub‑committees
and Working groups as he may deem necessary;
(h) to perform such other
functions and exercise such other powers as may be entrusted to him by the
Board or the Committee from time to time and
(i) to delegate any of his powers
to any officer of the University subject to such conditions as may deem
necessary.

The Pro-Vice-Chancellor Administration and Finance

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
12. The Pro‑Vice‑Chancellor
Administration and Finance.‑‑(1) Subject to the overall
supervision of the Vice‑Chancellor, the Pro‑Vice‑Chancellor
Administration and Finance shall be incharge of the administrative and
financial affairs of the University and shall formulate and recommend to the
Committee or the Council for approval, Rules, and Regulation relating to
financial and administrative matters of the University.
(2) The Pro‑Vice‑Chancellor
administration and finance shall have powers:
(a) to liaise with Government
agencies, local bodies and other authorities in connection with the financial
and administrative affairs of the University;
(b) to administer the financial
resources of the University;
(c) to administer the residences
of the students, teachers and other staff members of the University;
(d) to supervise the extra‑curricular
and recreational activities of the University, including the matters of health
and general welfare;
(e) to maintain discipline in the
University;
(f) to sanction expenditure
provided for in the approved budget in accordance with the Rules;
(g) to appoint staff members of
the University against vacant posts in accordance with the Rules and
Regulations;
(h) to engage such casual
workers, subject to budgetary provisions, as may he required from time to time;
(i) to initiate disciplinary
actions against the employees of the University and impose penalties, including
suspension, removal or dismissal from service in the University in accordance
with the Rules and Regulations;
(j) to perform such other
functions and exercise such other powers, as may be entrusted to him by the
Board, the Committee, the Council of the Vice Chancellor; and
(k) to delegate any of his powers
to any officer of the University subject to such conditions as he may deem
necessary.

The Pro-Vice-Chancellor Academic Affairs

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
13. The Pro‑Vice‑Chancellor
Academic Affairs.‑‑(1) The Pro‑Vice- Chancellor Academic
shall be incharge of the academic affairs of the University and shall assist
the Vice‑Chancellor on matters related to teaching, research, academic
programmes, extension and other development projects.
(2) Subject to the overall
supervision of the Vice‑Chancellor he shall formulate and recommend to
the Committee or the Council for approval, Rules and Regulations relating to
academic and research matters of the University;
(3) The Pro‑Vice‑Chancellor
academic shall have powers;
(a) to liaise with University,
learning institutions, industry and other research organizations for
apprenticeship and placement of students, and other academic and research
activities;
(b) to submit recommendations to
the Council on the courses of study to be taught in the University giving due
consideration to the advice .of the Advisory Board and other bodies constituted
for the purpose;
(c) to supervise the admission of
the students to the courses of studies and examination of the University;
(d) to coordinate the award of
fellowships, stipends, medals and prizes;
(e) to arrange convocations;
(t) to make such arrangements for
the scrutiny of papers, marks and results as he may consider necessary;
(g) to coordinate the teaching
and research work of the schools or the faculties of the University;
(h) to control and manage the
publications and circulation of periodicals, magazines, journals and books and
dissemination of scientific, technological and other related information
pertaining to the degree programmes;
(i) to perform such functions and
exercise such other powers as may be entrusted or delegated to him by the
Board, the Committee, the Council or the Vice‑Chancellor, and
(j) to delegate any of his powers
to appropriate levels of management, subject to such condition as he may deem
necessary.

Dean

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
14. Dean.‑‑(1)
Each Dean shall be appointed for a fixed period which may be extended by the
Committee.
(2) Subject to the overall
supervision of the Vice‑Chancellor, each Dean shall have powers:
(a) to ensure proper
implementation of the Rules and Regulations relating to his school or faculty;
(b) to regulate the conduct and
discipline of the students of his school or faculty and impose penalties,
including cancellation of the enrollment of the students;
(c) to coordinate, advise and
liaise with the Advisory Board Pro‑Vice- Chancellor Academic, other
academic authorities and Pro‑Vice‑Chancellor Administration and
Finance for teaching, research extension, development works and administrative
matters,;
(d) to present candidates for
admission to degrees, except honorary degrees, in the course falling within the
purview of the school or faculty;
(e) to appoint examiners for all
examinations of his respective school or faculty
(f) to direct teachers, students
and staff members of his school or faculty to take up such assignments in
connection with teaching and research as may consider appropriate;
(g) to nominate teachers,
students and staff members of his school or faculty for training fellowship,
scholarships and other academic distinctions; and
(h) to perform such other duties
and exercise such other powers as may be assigned to or vested in him by the
Board, the Committee, the Council or Vice‑Chancellor.

Board of Trustees

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
15. Board of Trustees.‑‑(1)
The overall control of the University shall vest in the General Council of the
Society which shall function as the Board of Trustees of the University.
(2) Changes in the composition of
the Board of Trustees shall be made on the recommendations of the General
Council of the Society.
(3) In particular and without
prejudice to the generality of the foregoing provisions, the Board of Trustees
shall have powers:‑‑
(a) to approve the creation of
new components of the University as school, faculty or any other teaching or
research unit;
(b) to approve changes in the
constitution of the Committee, Council or any other body of the University and
nominate members on the Authorities of the University as prescribed under this
Ordinance.
(c) to perform all such other
activities as may be required for furtherance of the objectives of the
University; and
(d) to delegate any of its powers
to the Committee, the Council, or other appropriate levels of management,
subject to such conditions as it may deem fit to impose.
(4) The President and Secretary
of the Society shall act as Chairman and Secretary of the Board of Trustees and
shall perform such duties and such power as may be entrusted or delegated to
him by Board of Trustees.

Board of Governors

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
16. Board of Governors.‑‑(1)
The general supervision and control of administrative/academic and financial
affairs, and the power to lay down the policies of the University shall vest in
the Board of Governors. It shall consist of the following members:
NOMINATED MEMBERS
(a) Vice‑Chancellor;
(b) Two Deans to be nominated by
the Chancellor in consultation with the Governing Council of the Society;
(c) Six persons nominated by the
Governing Council of the Society, prominent in their field of specialization;
(d) Two prominent educationists
to be nominated by the Council of the Society
EX OFFICIO MEMBERS
(a) One Judge of the Balochistan
High Court, to be nominated by the Chief Justice of the High Court;
(b) Chairman University Grants
Commission;
(c) One Vice‑Chancellor of
a University in Balochistan to be nominated by the Patron;
(d) Secretary Education,
Government of Balochistan.
(2) a nominated member of the
Board shall hold office for term of two years and shall be eligible for
renomination on the expiry of his term unless the Board for reasons to be
recorded terminates his membership earlier.
(3) The office of a nominated
member shall become vacant if he resigns or fails to attend three consecutive
meetings of the Board without sufficient cause or leave of absence.
(4) A casual vacancy in the
office of a member of the Board shall be filled by the authority which had
nominated the member whose vacancy is to be filled.
(5) The Chancellor shall be the
Chairman of Board of Governors.
(6) No act or proceedings of the
Board shall be invalid by reasons of only the existence of a vacancy in or any
defect in the constitution of the Board.

Powers and Functions of the Board of Governors

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
17. Powers and Functions of
the Board of Governors.‑‑(1) The Board of Governors shall
exercise powers and perform functions as follows:
(a) to formulate or approve the
principles, policies and plans governing the activities and operation of the
University so as to facilitate research, teaching and other academic work;
(b) to propose rules and
regulations;
(c) to prepare or have prepared
and revise from time to time rules and regulations for the efficient and
effective operation of the University;
(d) to create a component of the
University such as faculties/departments/institutes under its jurisdiction and
to constitute such standing committees, councils and other administrative or
academic /advisory bodies as it deems necessary, and review their work;
(e) to consider plans of work and
annual budget of the University for the approval of Executive Committee;
(f) to call for and consider
reports relating to the activities of the University and execution of the plans
of work and to direct the Chancellor to furnish information relating to any
matter specified by the Board;
(g) to create such academic or
administrative posts as it may deem necessary and to approve appointments to
such parts as it may specify;
(h) to constitute committees or
sub‑committees as it may deem necessary;
(i) to take all such initiatives
as it may consider necessary or desirable for the efficient and effective
management and functioning of the University; and
(j) to lay down its own rules of
procedure.
(2) The Board may delegate any of
its powers to the Chancellor/Vice- Chancellor subject to such conditions as it
may deem fit to impose.

Meetings of the Board of Governors

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
18. Meetings of the Board of
Governors.‑‑(1) The Board shall meet at least twice in a year
on the dates to be fixed by the Chancellor:
Provided that a special meeting
may be called at any time by the Chancellor or on a request by not less that
five members of the Board to consider any matter of urgent nature.
(2) In the case of a special
meeting not less than ten clear days notice shall be given to the members of
the Board, and the agenda of the meeting shall be restricted to the matter for
which the special meeting is called.
(3) The quorum for a meeting of
the Board shall be one half of its members, fraction being counted as one and
out of which not less than six shall be the nominated members.
(4) The decisions of the Board
shall be expressed in terms of the views of the majority of the members present
and voting and if the members equally divided, the Chairman of the Board shall
have the power to exercise the casting vote.

The Executive Committee

BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1996
BALOCHISTAN JUNIPER UNIVERSITY
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of Juniper University
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 14th December, 1996]
No. LEGIS.I‑108/LAW/96,
dated 14‑12‑1996. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 30th November, 1996, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑---
19. The Executive Committee.‑‑(1)
Without prejudice to the generality of the Control of the Board, the general
supervision and control of the affairs of the University shall vest in the
Executive Committee which shall, subject to reconstitution and expansion from
time to time, consist of the following members, namely:
(a) Vice‑Chancellor, who
shall be Chairman of the Committee;
(b) The Pro‑Vice‑Chancellors;
(c) The Chief Secretary
Balochistan or his nominee;
(d) Chairman University Grants
Commission or his nominee;
(e) Six persons of eminence to be
nominated out of which three would be nominated by the Chancellor and other
three by the Society;
(f) Education Secretary,
Government of Balochistan;
(2) A person nominated by the
